execution_plan: Initialize left=0, right=11, left_max=0, right_max=0, wSum=0.
Step 1: height[0] < height[11] (0 < 1). left_max updated to 0. left moves to 1.
Step 2: height[1] >= height[11] (1 >= 1). right_max updated to 1. right moves to 10.
Step 3: height[1] < height[10] (1 < 2). left_max updated to 1. left moves to 2.
Step 4: height[2] < height[10] (0 < 2). left_max is 1, water += 1 - 0 = 1. left moves to 3.
Step 5: height[3] >= height[10] (2 >= 2). left_max updated to 2. left moves to 4.
Step 6: height[4] < height[10] (1 < 2). left_max is 2, water += 2 - 1 = 1 (wSum=2). left moves to 5.

visualization_manifest.description: Initial state: pointers at edges, max bounds and water sum are 0.
height[0] < height[11]. left_max becomes 0. left pointer advances to 1.
height[1] >= height[11]. right_max updated to 1. right pointer moves to 10.
height[1] < height[10]. left_max updated to 1. left pointer moves to 2.
height[2] (0) < left_max (1). Trapped water increases by 1 (wSum = 1). left moves to 3.
height[3] (2) >= left_max (1). left_max updated to 2. left moves to 4.
height[4] (1) < left_max (2). Trapped water increases by 1 (wSum = 2). left moves to 5.
